statements.text: I’m comparing team-level counts of confirmed completed observable transfers (completed passes), not every ball movement.
Both teams completed 29 observable transfers altogether.
Home side completed 16 observable transfers. Home side had 55% overall possession by confirmed completed-pass share.
Away side completed 13 observable transfers. Away side had 45% overall possession by confirmed completed-pass share.
Home side completed more observable transfers. The difference was 3 completed observable transfers.

limitations: Ball positions are event-anchored and interpolated; speeds are 2D estimates, not measured strike speeds.
Centered smoothing uses future frames: this pipeline is offline and adds no claim of live latency.
Missing/rejected intervals contribute no distance; measured distance is partial coverage, not full ground truth.
Ownership and transfer detections are heuristic; opposite-team transfers can be interceptions, tackles or clearances.
Difficulty is a retrospective heuristic with a realized endpoint, not calibrated completion probability.
BAS-based checks are not independent because the supplied ball reconstruction uses those event anchors.
Clip alignment is inferred at approximately one-frame precision; goal direction is configurable.
Ball height is unavailable. Tracker IDs are not verified jersey numbers or player identities.
Goalkeeper/team assignment and panoramic calibration can introduce errors; GSR labels are preferred when available.
Confirmed pass share is the team's share of completed observable transfers, separate from possession attribution.
Transfers are observed ball movements; pressure, formation and difficulty remain estimates.
Coverage is not accuracy. One model-estimated pass is not a human-verified pass.
M19 prediction TTL differs from frozen M16; shorter-TTL ablation removes the new qualified pass.
M14 has better coverage than M16 on team_goal and southampton; neither is independently accuracy-validated here.
No supported short player links on these clips; no measured player identity improvement.
Full Tottenham–Arsenal CV processing remains deferred.
